institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Limited access to efficient cervical cancer screening
description: CerviSCAN is an indigenized cervical cancer screening system that combines artificial intelligence and robotics to support large-scale screening. The system includes AI-powered digital cytology, robotic slide staining, cytospin centrifugation, and indigenous monolayer smear preparation technologies. It is designed to improve the feasibility and efficiency of cervical cancer screening programs.
applications:
Hospitals, cancer care centers, and gynecology clinics
Diagnostic laboratories and pathology service providers
Public health screening and women's healthcare programs
Medical device and digital health technology companies
Government health departments, NGOs, and population screening initiatives
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Robotics, Automation & Drones
